failing.summary: commands/ahoy.md:53 says the user-settings audit raises "a `harness.stray_hook.<Event>` gap for each hook there that runs abcd". internal/core/ahoy/harness_strays.go (harnessFindings, id build at the `HarnessStrayHookGapPrefix + "." + idSafe(ev)` line) keys the first abcd hook on an event as `harness.stray_hook.<Event>` and every further hook on the same event as `harness.stray_hook.<Event>.<n>`, so two abcd hooks on one event yield ids the page does not name. The page's instruction to relay each gap's `detail` and `fix_hint` as they stand still works for either shape, so nothing an agent does on this page goes wrong; the id pattern is merely under-described. Smallest fix: append "(and `.<n>` for a second hook on the same event)" after `<Event>`. Not a release blocker.
failing.note: Minor wording omission (the gap id can carry a .<n> suffix for a second hook on one event); the page already tells the host to relay detail and fix_hint as they stand, so no action goes wrong.
